dex.entry: A moon-tide sprite that has gathered enough water to form a proper fluid body, hovering in a rotating sphere of water illuminated from within by crescent-light. It pulls at opponents with slow tidal forces. A moon living inside a sphere of water — hypnotic to watch and quietly threatening.

art.silhouette: Sphere of slowly rotating pale blue water with a luminous crescent core, small fine-featured face at the water surface, trailing water-arc tails; elegant floating orb at 48px.
